scope: Generic ANSI-256 conversion for custom RGB colors

reference.contract: ANSI-256 conversion applies the general nearest-color algorithm; it contains no exact-RGB lookup table. Semantic built-in color roles may retain authored indexes through capability palettes.

finding.issue: The generic downgrade_color path special-cased five exact RGB values to reproduce frozen semantic indexes. This caused user-supplied #3a3a3a to map to index 238 rather than the general result 237.

independent_red_probe.assertion: custom RGB #3a3a3a expected generic index 237 but received indexed color 238

change.resolution: Removed the exact-color lookup and route all RGB values through nearest_256. Kept semantic palette projection in CapabilityPalettes unchanged.
regressions: Custom RGB values #3a3a3a, #474747, #737373 and #808080 use their generic nearest ANSI-256 indexes.
A user-authored Theme::paper token follows generic conversion.
Junie semantic role indexes remain authored for ANSI-256 and Mono, and semantic Accent remains LightGreen in ANSI-16.
